entities.name: EAS discovery
entities.description: Procedure for discovering Edge Application Servers in 5GS as specified in 3GPP TS 23.548.

entities.name: EAS rediscovery
entities.description: Procedure for rediscovering Edge Application Servers when triggered by the network.

entities.name: ECS address provisioning
entities.description: Procedure for providing Edge Configuration Server configuration information to the UE over NAS.

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session establishment
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to establish a PDU session.

entities.name: Network-requested PDU session modification
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the network to modify an existing PDU session.

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session modification
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to modify an existing PDU session.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options IE
entities.description: Information Element used to carry DNS server addresses, EAS rediscovery information, ECS configuration information, and EDC support indications.

entities.name: Edge Application Server Discovery Function
entities.description: Network function selected by SMF to handle DNS messages for EAS discovery in session breakout or distributed anchor connectivity models.

entities.name: Local DNS server
entities.description: DNS server selected by SMF for EAS discovery in session breakout connectivity model.

entities.name: Edge DNS Client
entities.description: UE capability for edge DNS functionality that can be indicated to and configured by the network.

entities.name: Session Management Function
entities.description: Network function responsible for selecting EASDF, local DNS server, triggering EAS rediscovery, and providing ECS configuration information.

relations.description: Extended protocol configuration options IE is used during UE-requested PDU session establishment to carry DNS server addresses and capability indications.
Extended protocol configuration options IE is used during network-requested PDU session modification to provide DNS server addresses and ECS configuration information.
Extended protocol configuration options IE is used during UE-requested PDU session modification to carry capability indications and receive ECS configuration information.
SMF selects the EASDF and provides its IP address to the UE for EAS discovery.
SMF selects the local DNS server and can provide its IP address to the UE for EAS discovery.
SMF initiates network-requested PDU session modification to trigger EAS rediscovery when it decides to do so.
Extended protocol configuration options IE carries ECS configuration information during ECS address provisioning.
Extended protocol configuration options IE carries EDC support indications and network EDC configuration.
